The Company has allotted convertible warrants on a preferential basis to the Promoter as well as to certain Individuals, Body Corporates, and LLPs. Such Individuals, Body Corporates, and LLPs were not shareholders of the Company as on the date of allotment.
In accordance with the applicable disclosure requirements prescribed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), Warrant allottees who do not form part of the Promoter and Promoter Group and who are not the shareholder of the Company are classified under the Non Promoter - Non Public category. Accordingly, the details of the total number of warrants allotted to such allottees have been disclosed under the Non Promoter - Non Public shareholding section.
